question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure a SPAN session on a Cisco Nexus 5600 Series switch to rate-limit the mirrored traffic to 1 Gbps. Which configuration meets this requirement?
options:
interface Ethernet 1/3
 monitor session 2
 destination interface ethernet 1/5
 source interface rx

interface Ethernet 1/5
 monitor rate-limit 1G

interface Ethernet 1/3
 monitor rate-limit 1G
 destination interface ethernet 1/5
 source interface rx

interface Ethernet 1/5
 monitor session 2
 destination interface tx

interface Ethernet 1/3
 switchport monitor rate-limit 1G

monitor session 2
 destination interface ethernet 1/5
 source interface Eth 1/3

interface Ethernet 1/3 rx
 switchport mode SD
 switchport monitor rate-limit 1G
 monitor session2
 destination interface ethernet 1/5
theory: On Nexus 5600, SPAN mirrored traffic can be rate-limited directly on the destination interface using "switchport monitor rate-limit <rate>" so the copied traffic doesn't overrun the analyzer or congest the destination port, separate from the normal "monitor session" block that defines the source and destination relationship. Both pieces — the rate-limit under the destination interface and a standard monitor session pointing sources at that destination — are needed together to both mirror and throttle the traffic to 1 Gbps. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — SPAN Rate Limiting)
